choice.title: Remove previous versions first
choice.description: Quits and removes any earlier Credo or TokenMeter app before installing, for a clean install. Your saved history and settings are kept unless you also tick the next option.

choice.title: Also erase saved history and settings
choice.description: Deletes Credo's saved history, pricing file, preferences and widget positions, so Credo starts fresh and rebuilds its totals from the Claude logs still on this Mac.

choice.title: Install Credo __VERSION__
choice.description: Installs Credo in /Applications and opens it. Untick this and keep the options above ticked to uninstall Credo without installing it again.
